# featureflip_feature_flag (Resource)

A feature flag. Import with `<project>/<flag-key>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Boolean flags get true/false variations automatically.
resource "featureflip_feature_flag" "new_checkout" {
  project = featureflip_project.web.key
  key     = "new-checkout"
  name    = "New Checkout Flow"
  type    = "Boolean"
  tags    = ["checkout"]
}

# Non-Boolean flags declare their variations inline.
resource "featureflip_feature_flag" "banner_text" {
  project = featureflip_project.web.key
  key     = "banner-text"
  name    = "Banner Text"
  type    = "String"

  variations = [
    { key = "control", name = "Control", value = "Welcome!" },
    { key = "variant", name = "Variant", value = "Hi there!" },
  ]
}

# A temporary flag with an expiry date. Nothing changes at evaluation time
# when the date passes; the flag is reported as stale so it gets cleaned up.
resource "featureflip_feature_flag" "holiday_banner" {
  project    = featureflip_project.web.key
  key        = "holiday-banner"
  name       = "Holiday Banner"
  type       = "Boolean"
  expires_at = "2027-01-31T00:00:00Z"
}

# A kill switch that is meant to stay: permanent flags are never reported for
# cleanup. owner_email names the member who gets the flag's cleanup notices.
resource "featureflip_feature_flag" "payments_kill_switch" {
  project     = featureflip_project.web.key
  key         = "payments-kill-switch"
  name        = "Payments Kill Switch"
  type        = "Boolean"
  permanent   = true
  owner_email = "oncall-lead@example.com"
}

# owner_email and permanent are opt-in: omit them to leave the values to the
# dashboard (and, for owner_email, to the API's default of the creating user).
# Set them explicitly to manage them; owner_email = "" keeps a flag unowned.
resource "featureflip_feature_flag" "experiment" {
  project     = featureflip_project.web.key
  key         = "search-ranking-v2"
  name        = "Search Ranking v2"
  type        = "Boolean"
  owner_email = ""
  permanent   = false
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `project` (String)
- `type` (String) Flag type: Boolean, String, Number, or Json. Immutable.

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean)
- `client_side_visible` (Boolean)
- `description` (String)
- `expires_at` (String) Advisory date by which the flag is expected to be removed, as an RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. `2027-01-31T00:00:00Z`). Evaluation never changes when it passes; the flag is reported as stale so it can be cleaned up. It must be in the future when it is set or changed. A date that has since passed stays valid and causes no diff. Omitting it clears any expiry set on the flag.
- `owner_email` (String) Email of the organization member responsible for the flag; they get its cleanup notices. Compared case-insensitively. Set it to `""` to leave the flag unowned. Omitting it leaves the owner unmanaged: whatever the API assigned on create (the creating user, when that is a member rather than a service token) or someone set in the dashboard is kept. Reads as `""` when the flag has no owner. Setting an owner needs the Pro plan or above; clearing one is always allowed.
- `permanent` (Boolean) Marks a flag that is meant to stay (a kill switch, ops toggle or entitlement gate). Permanent flags are never reported for cleanup or past expiry; evaluation never changes. Can't be combined with expires_at. Set it to `false` to make the flag temporary. Omitting it leaves the marker unmanaged: whatever is set in the dashboard is kept.
- `tags` (Set of String)
- `variations` (Attributes List) Flag variations. Omit for Boolean flags (auto-seeded with true/false). Required for String/Number/Json flags. Variation keys are immutable; for Json flags, value holds the JSON document as a string. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variations))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import featureflip_feature_flag.new_checkout web/new-checkout
```
